---
name: Feature idea
about: Something Footnote should do that it doesn't
labels: enhancement
---

**What problem are you hitting?**
The situation, not the solution. "I stream in portrait and the lower-third clips" tells us more than "add portrait mode".

**What shape would the fix take?**
Rough is fine. If it touches what's allowed to reach the screen, note that — editorial changes work differently (see `HOW_FOOTNOTE_DECIDES.md`).

**Willing to build it yourself?**
No obligation either way — but if yes, say so and we'll talk approach before you write code. [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) covers the on-ramps, and the [`good first issue` label](https://github.com/jordanpeele/footnote/issues?q=label%3A%22good+first+issue%22) has pre-scoped work if you want something with exact file pointers.
